merge_state_triton: merge prefix and suffix attention outputs with numerically stable log-sum-exp combination using triton kernel
merge_state_kernel: run triton jit kernel to combine prefix and suffix state tensors per token and head with padded head size support
compute_merge_output_lse: compute merged log-sum-exp values for prefix and suffix attention states when output_lse is enabled
scale_merge_outputs: scale and merge prefix and suffix output tensors using their respective log-sum-exp values
handle_inf_lse_values: handle infinite log-sum-exp values by converting them to negative infinity before merging
